Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. George Munsey and Michael Jones will open the batting for Scotland. Jacob Duffy will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

It's been a tough day at the office for the home side so far. Once again they were hit out of the mark right from the first over. Chris Greaves was the only bowler who went for around 7 runs per over. All the other bowlers were expensive and went for over 10 runs in each of their overs. They had no answers to the power-hitting shown by the Kiwis batters. A daunting task lies ahead of them. They need to bat with the same aggressive intent as the New Zealand batters did.

This was power-hitting at its absolute best! New Zealand started firing right from the word go! Dane Cleaver and Finn Allen came out to bat with some aggressive intent. Finn Allen did perish soon, but Mark Chapman continued with his brutal hitting. He notched up crucial partnerships with Daryl Mitchell and Michael Bracewell and put Scotland under immense pressure. Mark Chapman departed after a well-made 83 but Michael Bracewell and James Neesham put a stand of 79 runs off 29 balls and guided New Zealand over 250. Michael Bracewell remained unbeaten on 61, while James Neesham was dismissed on the final ball over the innings after a 12-ball 28. They will be mighty, mighty pleased with that batting performance.

It's been yet another blistering batting performance from the Kiwis. With 254 on the board, Mitchell Santner's decision to bat first has surely been justified here. Anything the batters touched during the innings turned to gold! There was no stopping them. New Zealand have notched up their highest T20I total! Scotland will be disappointed with their bowing performance. They have a mountain to climb now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket to end an outstanding batting performance! Gavin Main serves this on a length and outside off, James Neesham looks to swing across the line only to get a leading edge high into the sky. Mark Watt at third man settles under it and it takes forever to get to him. The birthday boy makes the catch look easy! However, the damage has already been done and New Zealand have posted 254 runs on the board!
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Watt b Gavin Main

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Crunched! Tad shorter, around middle. James Neesham slaps this one towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Leg bye! A length ball, on the pads. Michael Bracewell misses his flick and gets hit on his pads. The ball rolls away towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!
A single of the Free Hit! Good-length delivery, around middle. James Neesham flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

No ball and Leg bye! This one angles in again, length ball, around the leg pole. Michael Bracewell misses his heave this time. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards point. Another leg bye taken! Gavin Main has also overstepped here! No ball called. Free Hit is coming up!
Leg bye! Angling in, on a length, around the leg pole. James Neesham looks to heave this one over but he misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards point. Leg bye taken!
SIX! A maximum to begin the over with! A shorter one, around middle. James Neesham swivels and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie!

SIX! Oh my.. Scotland are been taken to the cleaners! Alasdair Evans serves this short and wide. Michael Bracewell is down the wicket as he slashes this towards deep backward point and clears the boundary with ease! 26 runs of the over!

SIX! Michael Bracewell brings up his maiden T20I half-century in style! Alasdair Evans geoes full outside off, Michael Bracewell gets across the line and lifts it over deep sqaure leg for a maximum! Michael Bracewell has had a wonderful summer with the bat and is proving to be quite an all-rounder!

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Alasdair Evans goes short and outside off, Michael Bracewell gets across the stumps and pulls this towards deep square leg for four more runs! That brings up the fifty-run partnership between these two in just 20 deliveries!

FOUR! Michael Bracewell has been hitting the ball really well! Alasdair Evans bowls a low full toss outside off, Michael Bracewell reaches out and places it through cover-point for another boundary! He is now one hit away from his half-century!
WIDE! Bangs in a slower delivery outside off, Michael Bracewell stretches for it and misses. The umpire calls this wide.
FOUR! This one has been dispatched! Alasdair Evans goes full outside off, Michael Bracewell powers this to deep cover for a boundary!
Slower in the air and served full outside off, James Neesham powers this to long on for a single.
Pitches this one up, around middle and off. Michael Bracewell drives it down towards long on. Two taken!
FOUR! Mark Watt goes short and outside off, Michael Bracewell goes on the back foot and finds the gap in deep mid-wicket for a boundary!
Mark Watt goes short and angled into the batter, James Neesham pulls this to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! James Neesham has been in fine touch! Mark Watt attempts a yorker but bowls this on the full and James Neesham is not going to miss out. Lifts this high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
This is bowled on a yorker length outside off, Michael Bracewell paddle sweeps this straight to short fine leg and gets a single.
Mark Watt begins with a low full toss angled into the pads, Michael Bracewell clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle and off. Michael Bracewell digs this one out towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short and on middle. Michael Bracewell smashes this one towards deep square leg for a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Michael Bracewell drags it with the inner half of his bat towards long on for a brace.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short, around middle and off. Michael Bracewell steps down and punches it through cover for a boundary.
Slow again, short, around middle. James Neesham pulls it towards short fine leg for a single.
Leg bye! A slower one, outside off, on a length. Michael Bracewell walks across and looks to sweep this one. But he misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
SIX! Up and away! Overpitched delivery, around middle and off. James Neesham hammers this one over long on for a biggie!
Fuller one, slower through the air, outside off. James Neesham drives it towards cover.
Shortish ball, around middle. James Neesham flicks off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length, around middle. Michael Bracewell pulls it along the ground towards mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Scotland finally have got a breakthrough! An outstanding knock from Mark Chapman comes to an end! Chris Greaves has struck this time. A shorter one, around middle. Mark Chapman swivels and mistimes his pull shot. The ball flies high and goes towards deep square leg. Mark Watt there pouches it safely. James Neesham is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Watt b Chris Greaves

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! A googly, outside off, shorter one. Mark Chapman looks to pull this away but he misses.
Alasdair Evans drops it short again, around middle. Mark Chapman pulls it towards square leg for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! These two are toying with the bowlers now! A fuller one, around middle. Mark Chapman makes room and smashes this over cover for a biggie!
A shorter one, around middle and leg. Michael Bracewell pulls it along the ground for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Shorter one now, around middle and off. Michael Bracewell dances down the pitch and pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller one, around middle and leg. Michael Bracewell gets down on his knee and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
A low full toss, around middle. Mark Chapman knocks it down to long on for a single.
Alasdair Evans has been brought back into the attack.
SIX! BANG! That was there to be hit! Fuller one, in the slot, around off. Michael Bracewell tonks it straight down the ground all the way for a biggie!
Fraction short, around off. Mark Chapman lifts it towards long off. The ball falls way short of the fielder there. Only a single.
Touch fuller, around off. Michael Bracewell advances down the pitch and pushes it towards long off for another line.
Tighter line this time, around off, shortish ball. Mark Chapman knocks it down the ground for a single.
SIX! Poor delivery and punished! Another short ball, outside off. Mark Chapman rocks back and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR! Pulled away! Short, around middle. Mark Chapman uses the depth of his crease and smashes this towards deep square leg for boundary.
Faster in the air and angled into the batter, Mark Chapman makes room and works this through cover for a single.
Goes short once again and Mark Chapman goes back and thumps it straight to cover-point.
Michael Leask goes quick and short outside off, Mark Chapman looks to cut this and gets beaqten on the outside edge.
Michael Leask goes full outside off, Mark Chapman hits this back to the bowler.

SIX! This has been dropped as it clears the boundary line! This is full and outside off, Mark Chapman hits this over long off. The fielder gets his hand to it but only manages to parry it over the ropes for six more runs!

FOUR! Mark Chapman continues on his merry way! Michael Leask serves this short outside off, Mark Chapman uses the crease and slaps this past backward point for a boundary! the fielder at fine leg puts in a dive but can not save four runs.

PUT DOWN! Richie Berrington the culprit! Scotland cannot afford to drop catches at this time! Fuller again, outside off. Michael Bracewell drives it uppishly towards cover. Richie Berrington gets his hands to the ball. But he spills it out in the end. Will that prove to be costly?
Outside off, fuller one. Michael Bracewell drives but it goes straight to the fielder at cover.
Quicker, around middle and leg, tad shorter. Mark Chapman flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
TWO WIDES! Down the leg side, fuller one. Michael Bracewell looks to sweep this one but he misses. Wide called! The keeper too fails to gather the ball and the batters sneak a run as well.
Tad fuller now, outside off. Michael Bracewell opes the face of the bat and dabs it towards point.
Shorter one now, outside off. Mark Chapman rocks back and cuts it towards point for a single.

Tosses this one up, full, around middle and leg. Mark Chapman flicks it wide of long on and takes a brace. Fifty for Mark Chapman! It's been a great knock so far! He brought up his fifty in just 27 balls. He will want to carry on till the end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hamza Tahir has the last laugh! Daryl Mitchell continues to attack and this time fails to clear the boundary! Hamza Tahir flights this one as well full outside off, Daryl Mitchell looks to heave this leg side and slices at the ball. Alasdair Evans takes a comfatable catch at wide long on and Daryl Mitchell's cameo comes to an end!
Commentary.Howout: c Alasdair Evans b Hamza Tahir

Commentary.Commentary: SIX That is three sixes in the over! Hamza Tahir flights this one full outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets low and plunders this over long on. Does not get the best of connections but manages to clear to fielder and get six more runs in his kitty!
This one is fired in short and outside off, Daryl Mitchell looks to cut and bottom edges it into the ground into the off side.

SIX! Daryl Mitchell joins the party! Hamza Tahir serves this one short and angling into the batter. Daryl Mitchell rocks back in the crease and pulls this over mid-wicket for one more maximum in the over!
This is short and in line with the stumps, Mark Chapman pulls this to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! Mark Chapman putting the pressure straight on Hamza Tahir! This is fired in full outside off, Mark Chapman is down the wicket and just lifts this over long off for a biggie! He is now one hit away from his half-century!
Outside off, back of a length. Mark Chapman knocks it down to long off for a single. New Zealand are 103 for 2 at the halfway mark!

Excellent teamwork! Much fuller now, outside off. Mark Chapman heaves it in the gap towards deep square leg. The fielder runs to his left, dives, and makes a terrific stop. He throws the ball to the supporting fielder, who ran across from fine leg. Two taken!
Drifting in, on a shorter length, around middle. Daryl Mitchell flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Quicker this time, around middle and leg, shorter. Daryl Mitchell works it towards long on for a brace.
Tosses this one up, very full, outside off. Mark Chapman lifts it towards long off. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Another run taken!
Short, a leg-break, outside off. Daryl Mitchell walks across and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Daryl Mitchell punches it off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around the leg pole. Daryl Mitchell reverse-sweeps this one but straight to the fielder at point.
Tosses it up again, full and around middle. Daryl Mitchell steps down the pitch and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Pulls his length back now, outside off. Mark Chapman dabs it towards short third man for a single.
SIX! High and Handsome! Much slower now, tosses it up, full and outside off. Mark Chapman shuffles across, gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Back of a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell stays in his crease and dabs it towards cover for a quick single.
Scotland have been rotating their bowlers well but need to pick up wickets to restrict the scoring. New Zealand are scoring far too freely here.

FOUR! That is a freebie! Michael Leask serves a low full toss on the pads, Mark Chapman gets onto one knee and sweeps this towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary! 17 runs have come from this over!
Good bowl! Shorter one, width on offer. Mark Chapman looks to cut this away but he misses.
Shorter one, around middle. Daryl Mitchell shimmies down the track and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Daryl Mitchell gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it towards backward point for a brace.
SIX! KABOOM! Top shot! A fuller one, around middle. Daryl Mitchell dances down the pitch and heaves it high over the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR BYES! Bouns runs! Down the leg side, fuller one. Daryl Mitchell looks to reverse-sweep this one but he misses. The ball races away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Michael Leask comes into the attack.
Another shorter one, outside off this time. Mark Chapman pushes it down to long off. They run the first one fast and a misfield by the fielder there allows the batters to take a second run!
Short this time, around middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell knocks it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Tosses this one up, full and on middle. Mark Chapman taps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell pushes this off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Outside off, a shorter ball. Daryl Mitchell stays in his crease and dabs it towards the off side.
Quicker, flatter, around off. Daryl Mitchell steps down the pitch and misses his flick. He gets rapped on the pads.
Shorter one, around middle and off. Mark Chapman pulls this down to long on for a brace. New Zealand are 62 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Yorker this time, around middle and leg. Mark Chapman does well to dig this one.
On a length, around middle and off. Mark Chapman stays on the back foot and blocks it out.

OUT! TAKEN! Have we jinxed this! Alasdair Evans strikes this time and he gets rid of the dangerous, Dane Cleaver! Much-needed wicket for Scotland as Dane Cleaver was looking in fine touch. A fuller ball, around middle and off. Dane Cleaver shuffles across and tries to scoop this over fine leg. But the ball goes off the leading edge and towards the fielder at short third man. Michael Leask takes an easy catch there. New Zealand have lost their second wicket! Daryl Mitchell walks out to the middle now.
Commentary.Howout: c Oliver Hairs b Alasdair Evans

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller this time, outside off. Dane Cleaver makes room and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary.
This partnership is looking really good for New Zealand and they well be hoping to keep going! Elsewhere, West Indies have won the toss and chosen to bowl first against India!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, wide of off. Dane Cleaver leaves it alone. Wide called!
Angling in, on a length, down the leg side. Dane Cleaver backs away and taps it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

SIX! This has been deposited into the stands! Gavin Main gies full and strays into the pads, Mark Chapman just flicks this casually over the deep square leg boundary for a maximum! This looked so easy! That brings up the fifty for New Zealand!
Gavin Main continues bowling full and outside off, Dane Cleaver hits this back down the pitch and the bowler puts his hand down to parry the ball towards long off for a single.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Dane Cleaver punches this back towards the bowler.
Goes full and well outside off, Mark Chapman hits this down the ground towards long on, where the fielder dives to restrict the batters to a single.
Gavin Main goes full outside off, Dane Cleaver knocks this down to long on for a single.

FOUR! This has been placed wonderfully! Gavin Main goes full and angles the ball into the stumps, Dane Cleaver paddles this fine over the fielder and finds the fine leg bundary! Dane Cleaver is looking good here!
FOUR! What a shot this is! This is bowled quick and wide outside off from a shorter length. Mark Chapman plays this late and beats the fielder at third man for a boundary!
This is full and in line with the stumps, Mark Chapman hits this down the pitch put is stopped by the bowler as he dives to his left.
WIDE! Goes full and outside off, Mark Chapman looks to play and misses. The umpire feels it is beyond the wide line and gives an extra run.

FOUR! Great timing from Mark Chapman! Mark Watt serves this a fraction full and angling into the stumps, Mark Chapman hits this with a straight back past the bowler to the long on fence for a boundary! This has raced across the surface.
Beaten once more! Mark Watt serves this short and outside off, Mark Chapman looks to cut but the ball is too close and misses his outside edge.
Mark Watt fires this short and outside off, Mark Chapman looks to cut and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Mark Watt begins with a short delivery outside off, Dane Cleaver punches this down to long off for a single.
Mark Watt is introduced into the attack.

SIX! That messes up a really good over from Gavin Main! Attempts a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on off, Mark Chapman does not connect as well as he would have liked but manages to lift this over long off for a biggie! Still 7 runs from the over and a wicket!
Pulls his length back a bit and delivers this outside off, Mark Chapman guides this towards backward point.
This is full and outside off, Mark Chapman goes through with his shot and finds this cover fielder.
Goes 'round the wicket and serves this on a good length and angling into the batter. Mark Chapman looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge back down the pitch.
Wide! Down the leg side, fraction shorter. Mark Chapman looks to flick this one but he misses. Wide called!
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mark Chapman guides this towards mid-wicket.
Mark Chapman walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gavin Main strikes on his first ball and the centurion from the last game departs! Scotland have drawn first blood! Gavin Main serves this on a good length outside off, Finn Allen looks to heave this straight and mistimes the ball. It goes high towards mid on and Mark Watt settles under this and takes an easy catch. Scotland have the breakthrough and Finn Allen makes the long walk back!
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Watt b Gavin Main

Commentary.Commentary: Gavin Main has been brought into the attack.
FOUR! Crunched! A length ball, around off. Dane Cleaver makes room and slaps this one through cover for a cracking boundary. 13 runs off the over!
Cheeky! Good-length delivery, around off. Dane Cleaver walks across and scoops it towards the fielder at fine leg. Two taken!
Outside off, slightly shorter. Dane Cleaver stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses.
SIX! BANG! On a length again, around off. Dane Cleaver dispatches this one high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Great intent shown by Dane Cleaver!
Leg bye! Another length ball, around middle. Finn Allen shuffles across and tries to flick this away but he misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Alasdair Evans begins with a length ball, tailing back in, around off. Finn Allen blocks it out watchfully.
Alasdair Evans will bowl from the other end.
This is short once again, and outside off, Dane Cleaver goes on the back foot and punches it straight to cover.
Bowls a quicker delivery short and angled into the pads, Finn Allen looks to work this leg side and misses. Gets a leg bye in the process.

SIX! Finn Allen starts off even better! Hamza Tahir floats this full on middle and leg, Finn Allen shuffles down the wicket and lofts this over long on for a maximum! This is proving to be an expensive over to begin!
Hamza Tahir serves this a fraction short and on middle, Dane Cleaver goes back in the crease and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and outside off, Dane Cleaver knocks this one straight to cover.

FOUR! Intent showed straight away! Hamza Tahir flights this one full outside off, Dane Cleaver is down the wicket as he lifts this over cover for a boundary to deep cover! New Zealand are on their way!
We are all set for action to get underway! The players are out in the middle. Finn Allen and Dane Cleaver will open the batting for New Zealand. Hamza Tahir will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Richie Berrington the captain of Scotland says that he would have looked to bat as well. Says the surface looks good and spinners could come to play. Adds that they took positives from the last game and will look to perform better in this game. Informs that they have made three changes to their side.

Mitchell Santner the skipper of New Zealand says that they are going to bat first and the wicket looks good. Mentions that they put on a complete performance in the previous game, which was nice to see. Further adds that this is a used wicket and the spinners should come into play later on. Informs that they have made three changes and Michael Rippon will be making his debut.

Scotland (Playing XI) - George Munsey, Michael Jones (In for Calum MacLeod), Oliver Hairs, Richie Berrington (C), Matthew Cross (WK), Chris Greaves, Michael Leask, Mark Watt, Gavin Main (In for Safyaan Sharif), Alasdair Evans (In for Chris Sole), Hamza Tahir.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Dane Cleaver (WK), Mark Chapman (In for Martin Guptill), Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner (C), Michael Rippon (In for Glenn Phillips), Ish Sodhi, Jacob Duffy (In for Lockie Ferguson), Ben Sears.
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

Scotland on the other hand will need to put their A-game forward to beat the strong Kiwi side. They fought hard in the previous game but the target was just too big enough for them. Their bowlers will need to be more disciplined this time around. The seamers in particular. Although the task to defeat New Zealand might be challenging, Scotland are capable of getting over the line. Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
